name: repl_paste_syntax
title: Consecutive top-level 'if' blocks pasted into a REPL cause SyntaxError
symptom: Pasting a multi-statement script into a Python REPL fails with IndentationError or SyntaxError
cause: The REPL parses consecutive top-level compound statements as one block and fails on the second
fix: Wrap each statement in a function, add explicit newlines between compound statements, or execute from a file
